{{Top|leg}}
'''Thermal grenades''' were a type of [[Grenade/Legends|grenade]] possibly related to [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonators]] in function.

They were carried by [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE/sa bombers]].
